high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "theinfomance." The post features a photograph of a person installing or working on a device mounted on a pole, which appears to be part of a landslide warning system. The individual is standing on a hillside with a road visible in the background, where several vehicles are parked or moving along the curve. The text overlay on the image reads: "Infomance Landslide Warning System" at the top, followed by a description stating, "IIT Mandi has developed a Landslide Warning System which predicts landslides in advance.
